# John O'Laughlin
**John O'Laughlin** is a transportation designer who interned at the Hot Wheels design team in 2018. During his time at Hot Wheels he designed a total of four models. After his stint at Hot Wheels, he moved to Honda Advance Design and then Tesla, both for additional internship opportunities.
